manifest.selectionPolicy: At least 150 representative answers PER queryClass (branded and non-brand separately), across two or more industries in each population; independently sampled from authorized non-sensitive sources. Keep complaint-enriched, adversarial, and rare-class additions in the challenge sample. Require at least 25 adjudicated examples of each stance within each query class across the two samples. Themes are deferred; label intended-subject presence, stance and conclusion evidence only.
manifest.reviewPolicy: Two independent reviewers label without model predictions. Retain reviewer label records, hashes, adjudication, exact source hashes, split and Property/query-family/sweep identities. Assess semantic support of accepted model evidence separately after blind adjudication.
manifest.sourceStatus: The original 32 development answers and independent human-reviewed held-out answers were not supplied with this implementation plan. Empty examples are intentional; synthetic tests do not substitute for those labels.
